criteria.name: Originality
criteria.description: Degree to which the work presents independent thought and authentic student voice rather than copied material.

levels.label: Unacceptable
levels.descriptor: Extensive unoriginal or unattributed text spanning major portions of the document.

levels.label: Deficient
levels.descriptor: Substantial reliance on external sources with minimal original synthesis or independent thinking.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Moderate original thought present, but significant reliance on source passages without transformation.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Largely original voice and ideas throughout; minor, isolated unoriginal phrasing.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Consistently original work reflecting independent critical thinking and a unique authentic perspective.

criteria.name: Citation Quality
criteria.description: Accuracy, completeness, and consistency of references, citations, and attribution.

levels.label: Unacceptable
levels.descriptor: No citations provided or references appear fabricated or entirely absent.

levels.label: Deficient
levels.descriptor: Infrequent, highly inconsistent, or severely incomplete citation details throughout.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Basic citations present, but missing key details (page numbers, years) or improperly formatted.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Accurate, consistent citations following standard academic style with minor formatting lapses.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Flawless, exhaustive citation and bibliographic attribution adhering strictly to standards.

criteria.name: Use of Sources
criteria.description: How effectively external scholarship is integrated, paraphrased, critiqued, and synthesized.

levels.label: Unacceptable
levels.descriptor: Sources misused, misunderstood, or dropped in without synthesis or context.

levels.label: Deficient
levels.descriptor: Superficial stringing together of quotations or patchwriting with minimal framing.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Sources quoted accurately but integrated clumsily into arguments; limited critical evaluation.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Sources effectively summarized, accurately paraphrased, and logically integrated to support claims.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Masterful synthesis and critical interrogation of diverse scholarship, enriching all core arguments.

criteria.name: Writing Clarity
criteria.description: Clarity of prose, structure, conciseness, academic tone, and avoidance of convoluted or tortured phrasing.

levels.label: Unacceptable
levels.descriptor: Prose is incoherent, disjointed, or obscures core meaning throughout.

levels.label: Deficient
levels.descriptor: Pervasive structural errors, tortuous syntax, or confusing word substitutions impair readability.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Generally understandable, but hampered by passive constructions, wordiness, or awkward transitions.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Clear, organized, and fluent academic prose with appropriate vocabulary and logical transitions.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Exceptionally lucid, concise, and eloquent writing that engages the reader effortlessly.
